blocks.text: TOKYO — Elizaveta Kuznetsova has made history as the first-ever Moldovan to win the Miss International title, and she did so by also marking her country’s debut in the global tilt. It is the first time that the European nation has participated in the Japan-based international pageant this year, only on its 64th edition, and it has already reclaimed the title for the continent, four years since Germany’s Jasmine Selberg won the cronw. The 26-year-old Kuznetsova bested 72 other aspirants at the Final Gala held at Kanadevia Hall (formerly Tokyo Dome City Hall) in Tokyo, Japan, on Nov. 25, and inherited […]...
